## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

ProfileScreen — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileScreen.kt

## Trigger

A configuration change (rotation) recreating the composable — observed

## Today

`ProfileScreen` holds `hrMaxEditValue` in a plain `remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }`
(line 43). The other editable fields on the same screen — `fieldValue` in
`ZoneThresholdField`, `distanceFieldValue` and `longPressFieldValue` in
`SettingsFields` — use the same plain `remember`, not `rememberSaveable`. A
configuration change (rotation) recreates the composable and its `remember`
state is lost, discarding whatever the user had typed and, for
`hrMaxEditValue`, closing the edit dialog since it is driven by that same
state being non-null.

## Expected

`hrMaxEditValue`, and the other in-progress field values on `ProfileScreen`
(`fieldValue`, `distanceFieldValue`, `longPressFieldValue`), are held in
`rememberSaveable` so a rotation keeps the value the user has typed, the
same as every other in-progress input on the screen.
